messages:
Maria: Hey team — ACME POC wraps up this Friday. We need a concrete deprovision plan for the POC environment: hosted API keys, dedicated pool tear-down, VPC peering, log/snapshot retention and proof for security. Who can own which pieces?

Ajay: I can own hosted API keys + final access report. Will need the key list and creation audit.

Sam: I’ll take the dedicated pool teardown. Note: must drain connections first and evict model caches, otherwise we risk 500s for any late requests.

Kevin: Security checklist: confirm retention windows (customer agreed to 30 days for logs/backups), validate S3 objects are encrypted, and perform crypto-shred on backups if requested. Also need sign-off for deleting KMS aliases used for the POC.

Eva: Heads up — VPC peering and NAT gateways can keep billing if not deleted. Also double-check any route table entries and DNS records in the customer-hosted zone.

Jordan: For Dedicated nodes: flush KV cache and remove any uploaded model artifacts. If we leave cached embeddings/snapshots they might persist in /var/lib/redwood/cache — need a safe wipe.

Maria: Great. Drafting action list here: 
1) Invalidate hosted API keys and produce revocation audit -> Ajay
2) Drain + teardown dedicated pool (evict caches, delete autoscale policies) -> Sam
3) Remove VPC peering, routes, security groups, and delete NAT gateway -> Sam + Eva
4) Delete S3 artifacts older than 30d and run crypto-shred on backups -> Kevin
5) Revoke IAM roles and service principals created for the POC -> Ajay
6) Confirm billing stops for dedicated pool and any infra -> Liam (finance)
7) Update CRM/op notes and attach deliverable checklist -> Maria

Ajay: Revoke hosted keys example (admin-only):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/keys/revoke 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_TOKEN' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"key":"sk-prod-ACME-poc-XXXX"}'
```
Will collect the list and put the audit into the sales folder.

Sam: Teardown plan: 
- Set pool to drain mode (grace period 10m)
- Stop accepting new sessions 
- Run `redwoodctl cache flush --pool poc-acme`
- Scale down to 0, then delete pool resource
I’ll run this on Sun 02:00 UTC to avoid traffic.

Sam: command snippet I’ll run: 
```
redwoodctl pools update poc-acme --drain=true --grace=600
redwoodctl cache flush --pool poc-acme --yes
redwoodctl pools delete poc-acme --confirm
```

Eva: For VPC side: remove peering, then delete route entries, and finally delete the peering connection and NAT. I’ll make a runbook with exact console/cli steps.

Kevin: On backups: confirm where snapshots are stored. If in S3 with prefix `acme/poc/`, we should run: 
```
aws s3 rm s3://redwood-backups/acme/poc/ --recursive --exclude "*last-30-days*"
# then call crypto-shred process for remaining encrypted backups per policy
```
I need access to the bucket and KMS aliases.

Liam: Finance will watch for billing cutover. Please mark pool deletion time and share resource IDs. I’ll verify no residual committed usage.

Maria: @Ajay @Sam @Kevin please update this thread when you start/finish each bullet. We need proof for the customer and internal audit.

deploy-bot: Automated note: Dedicated pool `poc-acme` snapshot created at 1769590000 and uploaded to s3://redwood-backups/acme/poc/snap-1769590000.tar.gz

Sam: Starting drain now (setting drain flag). Will post progress.

Sam: Drain complete, caches flushed. Next: pool scale -> delete.

Ajay: Revoked hosted keys for ACME POC. Attached revocation list to /sales/acme/poc/keys-revocation.csv and uploaded to secure drive.

Kevin: Performed S3 cleanup and triggered crypto-shred on archived snapshots older than 30 days. KMS aliases scheduled for rotation and then delete after retention window (per legal).

Eva: VPC peering removed, NAT gateway deleted, route tables cleaned. Confirmed no routes to customer VPC remain.

Liam: Billing check complete. No further charges from dedicated pool after deletion time. Will file the invoice reconciliation.

Maria: Thanks all — can everyone react with :white_check_mark: when you've uploaded their proof to the sales folder? We need the audit package by Monday EOD.

Ajay: :white_check_mark: uploaded keys revocation and admin audit.

Sam: :white_check_mark: pool deletion logs and `redwoodctl` output in /ops/logs/poc-acme/176959*.log.

Kevin: :white_check_mark: S3 deletion manifest and shred confirmation in secure bucket.

Eva: :white_check_mark: network teardown runbook + console screenshots uploaded.

Liam: :white_check_mark: billing confirmation filed.

Maria: Closing thread — thanks team. I’ll attach the combined package to the customer and mark POC as completed in CRM.

Jordan: Quick note: freed model cache reduced our infra delta cost by ~12% for the month — nice win.

Maria: Noted. Closing at 1769601234."
